title: Shattering Italian Pasta
description: A quick and delicious Italian pasta dish made with shattering vegetables.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the Italian pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced shattering bell pepper and cook for 3-4 minutes or until tender.
Add the sliced knotty zucchini and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until tender.
Mince the garlic and add to the skillet, cooking for 1 minute.
Stir in salt and black pepper to taste.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the vegetables.
Toss everything together and serve hot.
